measurement_method.source: Pinned upstream archives, not checkout/lock measurements
measurement_method.lines: LF count plus final unterminated line; comments and blanks included
measurement_method.suffixes: Pinned Zed registrations; suffix matches alone do not establish language identity
measurement_method.archive_measurements: Initial screening with common directory exclusions and generated-header checks; implementation counts are heuristic, not an assertion that all files are handwritten
measurement_method.scoped_measurements: Second archive pass applies source_roots, exclude_paths, excluded_path_pattern and generated-header checks; inline tests/examples and unmarked generated code may remain
measurement_method.generated_header_pattern: auto[- ]?generated|generated (by|from)|DO NOT EDIT|DO NOT MODIFY|automatically generated
measurement_method.source_scope_application: Selection evidence and evaluation preparation only. corpus clone fetches entire repositories and its lock measurements count all matching tracked UTF-8 files. Downstream evaluation must apply the scope before readiness is approved.

overlap_check.method: Compare Git blob identities for scoped matching files larger than 300 bytes across candidate trees and existing corpus checkouts; exact-copy check only, not fuzzy clone detection.
overlap_check.limitations: SourceHut candidates were inspected by archive but excluded from GitHub-tree overlap comparison. Near copies, smaller files and future fetched dependencies require review before evaluation.
